profile.Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science - NTU
profile.Civilian Occupation: Software Engineer / Team Supervisor at LumaSoft; Lumina's workplace supervisor.
profile.Strengths: Software engineering, DevOps, system monitoring, operational analysis, leadership, practical judgement, organisation, investigation, teamwork, attention to detail, problem-solving, and identifying recurring issues.
profile.Weaknesses: Iris has limited experience in direct combat and is not naturally inclined towards offensive magic. Her analytical abilities depend on concentration, observation, and access to useful information. She sometimes becomes overly protective of the people under her care and may struggle to delegate when she believes a problem is her responsibility.
profile.Fear: Failing to notice a warning sign that could have prevented someone from being injured, particularly a teammate or someone she supervises.
profile.Mentor: Luma Ophiuchus; Luma Blossom and Luma Flora are not officially registered.
profile.Relationship: Married to Marcus Tan (Luma Chroma). Married at approximately 32–33 years old.
profile.Close bonds: Luma Blossom (Lumina), Luma Chroma (Marcus), Luma EmberFlora (Sylvia), members of Wildflowers; Emberbuds community. Supervisors and Colleagues at Lumasoft;
profile.Loves: Her husband, Blossom, the Emberbuds, supporting her team, seeing others succeed, and knowing that the people she cares about are safe.
profile.Likes: Guardian merchandise, organising fan activities, well-maintained systems, efficient workflows, problem-solving, thoughtful designs, and spending time with her husband.
profile.Dislikes: Unnecessary overtime, poor communication, avoidable system failures, disorganised work, people neglecting their health, and being kept out of important decisions.
profile.Hates: Exploitation, abuse of authority, deliberate manipulation, and anyone recklessly endangering other people.
profile.Hobbies: Organising Emberbuds events, collecting Blossom merchandise, working on fan projects, reviewing Marcus's designs, exploring cafés, and occasionally experimenting with personal software projects.
profile.Personality: Mira is practical, dependable, and organised, with a naturally protective attitude towards the people under her care. As a workplace supervisor, she is approachable but firm, particularly when employees neglect their responsibilities or push themselves beyond reasonable limits. She values efficiency, clear communication, and thoughtful planning, although she is capable of adapting quickly when unexpected problems arise. Outside work, Mira reveals a considerably more enthusiastic side as the founder of the Emberbuds, openly expressing her admiration for Blossom and enjoying the community she helped create. Despite being a devoted fan, she remains sensible and respectful of Guardian boundaries. Her relationship with Marcus is affectionate and comfortable, built around mutual support and shared creative interests. After awakening as Iris, Mira approaches Guardian life with the same practical mindset she applies to her civilian career, preferring analysis, coordination, and meaningful behind-the-scenes contributions rather than unnecessary attention or direct combat.
Personality Example: When Lumina repeatedly works through her lunch break, Mira eventually approaches her desk and reminds her that completing a task does not require sacrificing her health.

During an Emberbuds activity, Mira becomes unusually enthusiastic about a newly released Blossom merchandise design, discussing its details with considerably more excitement than she normally displays at work.

When Marcus shows her a new Emberbuds poster, Mira praises the overall design before asking whether the colours, spacing, and layout could be adjusted slightly. Marcus already knows that "slightly" may involve several revisions.

During Guardian training, Iris notices that a monitoring interface repeatedly reports the same irregularity. Instead of dismissing it as a harmless glitch, she investigates its pattern and discovers an underlying system issue.
profile.Fever Behaviour: Mira becomes unusually forgetful, emotional, and easily overwhelmed when feverish. Her normally organised and responsible personality gives way to a more dependent side, often seeking reassurance from Marcus. She becomes frustrated when she struggles to think clearly and may apologise repeatedly for being a burden. Despite insisting that she still has responsibilities to handle, she secretly enjoys being pampered by her husband and becomes reluctant to let him leave her side.
profile.Intoxicated Behaviour: Mira becomes extremely talkative and passionate about Emberbuds when intoxicated, often launching into lengthy, unsolicited rants about Blossom's popularity, merchandise, and fan activities. She enthusiastically discusses fan theories, defends Blossom against criticism, and complains about missed opportunities for Emberbuds merchandise. Once she starts, she becomes nearly impossible to stop, occasionally revealing just how much of a dedicated Blossom fan she really is, much to Lumina's embarrassment.
profile.Core Idea of character: A Guardian who discovers that protecting others does not always mean standing on the front line.
profile.Background:
Mira Tan is a software engineer and team supervisor at LumaSoft, where she oversees Lumina's civilian work. Approximately five years before her awakening, Mira was rescued by Luma Blossom during a collapsing-building incident. The warmth and protection of Blossom's burning petals left a lasting impression on her, inspiring her to establish the Emberbuds fan community. For years, she remained unaware that the Guardian she admired was also one of her employees.
Mira met Marcus through a freelance design project in her late twenties. Their relationship gradually developed into marriage, and Marcus later self-awakened as a Guardian. Mira knew that her husband was involved with the Guardian world but did not initially know his identity as Luma Chroma. He also regularly assisted with Emberbuds designs and merchandise.
In 2026, Mira's dormant Fire Core begins reacting and is eventually awakened by Blossom. Rather than becoming a regular front-line Guardian, Mira chooses the Ophiuchus training route, allowing her to retain her civilian career and contribute mainly through investigation, coordination, and technical support.
As Luma Iris, she develops precise magical diagnostic abilities that complement her knowledge of software engineering and DevOps. She frequently works alongside Fractal, whose structural analysis combines effectively with her ability to identify operational patterns and recurring anomalies. Although her responsibilities change, Mira remains dedicated to the Wildflowers, her husband, and the Emberbuds community.
Even after becoming a Guardian herself, Mira refuses to stop being an Emberbud.
